claude_proposed_widenings.name: restore_class_resource (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature restores Sorcery Points — a class-specific currency — not HP. ClassFeatureEffect only has GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. Neither can honestly encode a non-HP resource refill. This is the primary blocker.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can regain expended Sorcery Points, but no more than a number equal to half your Sorcerer level (round down)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: half_class_level_floor (DiceAmount or amount variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The recovery cap is floor(classLevel / 2). This does not fit any existing DiceAmount shape. DiceAmount is built around NdM+flat dice expressions; linear_per_level only supports integer per-level deltas and cannot express a half-level floor. A new amount variant or a dedicated numeric scaling kind is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: no more than a number equal to half your Sorcerer level (round down)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: short_rest_trigger (ClassFeatureActivationCost variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature fires at Short Rest completion, not as a turn action. The current ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'. Using 'free' is the least-wrong option (no action resource consumed) but misrepresents the trigger — the activation window opens at Short Rest end, not freely on the player's turn. A 'short_rest_trigger' cost kind would be more honest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain expended Sorcery Points
